title: HumanX: Toward Agile and Generalizable Humanoid Interaction Skills from Human Videos
abstract: arXiv:2602.02473v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Enabling humanoid robots to perform agile and adaptive interactions has long been a core challenge in robotics. Current approaches are bottlenecked by either the scarcity of realistic interaction data or the need for meticulous, task-specific reward engineering, which limits their scalability. To narrow this gap, we present HumanX, a unified framework that compiles human video into generalizable, real-world interaction skills for humanoids, without per-task design. HumanX integrates two co-designed components: XGen, an anchor-centric data generation pipeline that yields physically plausible robot interaction data from monocular video and augments it to create a diverse, scalable training dataset; and XMimic, an interaction-prioritized learning framework to achieve generalizable interaction skills from seconds of demonstration. translated_title: HumanX：从人类视频迈向敏捷且可泛化的人形机器人交互技能
translated_abstract: 让人形机器人能够执行敏捷且自适应的交互，长期以来一直是机器人学中的核心挑战。当前方法要么受限于真实交互数据的稀缺，要么需要对特定任务进行细致的奖励工程设计，这限制了其可扩展性。为缩小这一差距，我们提出了HumanX——一个统一框架，能够将人类视频直接编译为人形机器人可泛化的真实世界交互技能，且无需针对每个任务进行专门设计。HumanX集成了两个协同设计的组件：XGen，一个以锚点为中心的数据生成流水线，可从单目视频中生成物理上合理的机器人交互数据，并通过数据增强构建多样化、可扩展的训练数据集；以及XMimic，一个交互优先的学习框架，能够仅凭几秒钟的演示就习得可泛化的交互技能。该方法在五个不同领域进行了评估——篮球、足球、羽毛球、货物拾取以及反应性（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: HumanX通过协同设计的XGen数据生成流水线与XMimic交互优先学习框架，将人类视频直接转化为无需任务定制设计、可泛化的人形机器人敏捷交互技能。
en_tdlr: HumanX presents a unified framework that compiles human videos into generalizable, real-world humanoid interaction skills without per-task design, by co-designing the XGen anchor-centric data generation pipeline and the XMimic interaction-prioritized learning framework.
